content:
由于中国限制出口，西方买家正在为稀土支付高昂的溢价。 Sprott（多伦多证券交易所、纽约证券交易所股票代码：SII）表示，这些溢价能否帮助为中国境外的新矿山和炼油厂提供资金，取决于买家多年来保证的价格。 11 月 17 日，用于喷气发动机涂料的高纯度氧化钇在北美的交易价格约为每公斤 1,650 美元，大约是中国价格（约 9 美元）的 185 倍。 Sprott 的 Paul Wong 和 Jacob White 在 11 月 24 日的行业报告中写道，中国以外很少有加工商能够满足制造商所需的分离稀土。 “更高的价格无法迅速解决这种集中问题，”黄和怀特写道。 “安全供应需要分离、精炼、冶金和磁铁制造，而不仅仅是新矿山。”如今，买家为稀缺氧化物支付的价格几乎无法告诉贷款人炼油厂开业后的收入。具有最低价格的长期合同为贷款人提供了一个数字，可以用来判断该项目是否可以偿还建筑贷款。作者表示，钇价差可能会缩小，但即使溢价较小也可能使西方项目变得可行。在加利福尼亚州，MP Materials（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MP）与美国国防部签订了一项为期 10 年的协议，规定其销售或从其帕斯山矿山库存的产品中的钕-镨的底价为每公斤 110 美元。 MP 本月表示，截至 9 月 30 日的季度中，该公司获得了 810 万美元的价格保护收入。
澳大利亚莱纳斯稀土公司（ASX：LYC；美国场外交易市场代码：LYSCF）到 10 月底已为其一半以上的产量制定了最低价格。临时首席执行官 Pol Le Roux 在 10 月份对分析师表示，提供镝和铽以及钕和镨有助于莱纳斯赢得与磁铁制造商的长期合同。莱纳斯于 3 月份与日本 Jogmec 和 Sojitz 合资的 JARE 设定了稀土销售价格下限。 2025年5月，莱纳斯成为中国以外第一家分离重稀土氧化物生产商。根据国际能源署的数据，到 2024 年，中国开采了全球 60% 的磁铁稀土，精炼了 91%，并制造了 94% 的烧结永磁体。镝和铽有助于这些磁铁在电动机内的高温下保持其强度。 11月17日，欧洲氧化镝价格约为每公斤4,875美元，几乎是中国价格的22倍。 Sprott 引用的 Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 和彭博社数据显示，欧洲氧化铽的交易价格约为每公斤 10,500 美元，而中国的交易价格为每公斤 944 美元。据 Sprott 称，从 2025 年 11 月到 9 月，中国平均每月向美国出口 19.3 吨受控稀土化合物和金属，比 2024 年 6 月到 2025 年 3 月期间每月 76.8 吨下降了 75%。它使用了索罗德政策加速器 (Silverado Policy Accelerator) 的贸易数据，涵盖中国 2025 年 4 月出口管制全面覆盖的产品。这些数字不包括成品磁铁。
北京已暂停对稀土及相关技术更广泛的控制，直至 2027 年 1 月 10 日。4 月份的许可规则仍适用于某些稀土和磁体。南非 Steenkampskraal 矿区财务主管 Tyrone Searle 于 10 月向《北方矿业报》表示，该矿已在中国为首次精矿销售寻找买家，预计将于 2027 年初进行。该矿场归私营 Steenkampskraal 独居石矿所有。此后，该矿山运营商与法国 Remedy Metals 签署了一份不具约束力的协议，以测试他们是否可以在圣彼得堡分离稀土。

【原文 English Original】
Western buyers are paying steep premiums for rare earths as China restricts exports. Whether those premiums can help finance new mines and refineries outside China depends on the price buyers will guarantee for years, Sprott (TSX, NYSE: SII) says. High-purity yttrium oxide, used in jet engine coatings, traded at about $1,650 per kg in North America on Nov. 17, roughly 185 times the Chinese price of about $9. Few processors outside China can supply the separated rare earths manufacturers need, Sprott’s Paul Wong and Jacob White wrote in a Nov. 24 report on the sector. “Higher prices cannot quickly resolve this concentration,” Wong and White wrote. “Secure supply requires separation, refining, metallurgy and magnet manufacturing, not simply new mines.” The price a buyer pays for scarce oxide today tells a lender little about what a refinery will earn once it opens. A long-term contract with a minimum price gives the lender a figure it can use to judge whether the project can repay a construction loan. The yttrium price gap is likely to narrow, but even a smaller premium could make Western projects viable, the authors said. In California, MP Materials (NYSE: MP) has a 10-year agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense that sets a $110-per-kg floor for neodymium-praseodymium in products it sells or stockpiles from its Mountain Pass mine. MP booked $8.1 million in price protection income in the quarter to Sept. 30, the company said this month. Australia’s Lynas Rare Earths (ASX: LYC; US-OTC: LYSCF) had minimum prices in place for more than half its output by late October. Offering dysprosium and terbium alongside neodymium and praseodymium helps Lynas win longer contracts with magnet makers, Interim CEO Pol Le Roux told analysts in October. Lynas set up a price floor for rare earth sales in March with JARE, a venture involving Japan’s Jogmec and Sojitz. In May 2025, Lynas became the first producer of separated heavy rare earth oxides outside China. Export curbs China mined 60% of the world’s magnet rare earths in 2024, refined 91% and made 94% of its sintered permanent magnets, according to the International Energy Agency . Dysprosium and terbium help those magnets retain their strength at the high temperatures inside electric motors. In Europe, dysprosium oxide fetched about $4,875 per kg on Nov. 17, nearly 22 times the Chinese price. Terbium oxide traded at about $10,500 per kg in Europe against $944 in China, according to Benchmark Mineral Intelligence and Bloomberg figures cited by Sprott. China shipped an average of 19.3 tonnes a month of controlled rare earth compounds and metals to the U.S. from November 2025 through September, down 75% from 76.8 tonnes a month between June 2024 and March 2025, according to Sprott. It used trade figures from Silverado Policy Accelerator for products fully covered by China’s April 2025 export controls. The figures exclude finished magnets. Beijing has suspended broader controls on rare earths and related technology through Jan. 10, 2027. The April licensing rules still apply to certain rare earths and magnets. South Africa’s Steenkampskraal mine has lined up buyers in China for its first concentrate sales, expected in early 2027, Finance Chief Tyrone Searle told The Northern Miner in October. The operation is owned by privately held Steenkampskraal Monazite Mine. The mine operator and France’s Remedy Metals have since signed a non-binding agreement to test whether they can separate rare earths at Steenkampskraal. They plan to start with ore samples in a laboratory before deciding whether to run a pilot at the mine, Mining Weekly reported Wednesday. Equity financing Developers raising money by selling shares face a tougher market. The Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF (Nasdaq: REXC), which tracks rare earth companies outside China, closed at $11.09 Tuesday, down 30% from $15.76 on Sept. 30. A developer whose own shares fall must issue more of them to raise the same construction dollars. Wong and White attributed much of the sell-off to investors cutting positions bought with borrowed money as markets grew more volatile. Net inflows into Sprott’s fund topped $100 million between April and Nov. 17, according to Bloomberg data compiled by the asset manager.

title: 英伟达暂停向东南亚销售部分芯片，回应政府对华限制措施
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: ADAM SATARIANO, 孟建国2026年11月27日 随着特朗普政府进一步加紧切断中国企业获取美国算力的渠道，英伟达已暂停向东南亚四国销售部分最先进人工智能芯片。 据两名此次销售暂停情况的知情人士透露，马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚的数据中心运营商已有订单被搁置。因涉及非公开的商业往来，这两名人士要求匿名。 这一冻结措施威胁到全球增长最快的数据中心市场之一，该地区目前有价值数十亿美元的项目正在建设中。这种增长很大程度上由中国企业推动，它们通过租赁方式使用高性能的英
content:
ADAM SATARIANO, 孟建国2026年11月27日
随着特朗普政府进一步加紧切断中国企业获取美国算力的渠道，英伟达已暂停向东南亚四国销售部分最先进人工智能芯片。
据两名此次销售暂停情况的知情人士透露，马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚的数据中心运营商已有订单被搁置。因涉及非公开的商业往来，这两名人士要求匿名。
这一冻结措施威胁到全球增长最快的数据中心市场之一，该地区目前有价值数十亿美元的项目正在建设中。这种增长很大程度上由中国企业推动，它们通过租赁方式使用高性能的英伟达芯片，而美国出口管制禁止它们直接购买这些芯片。
美国商务部上周提出了旨在堵住这一漏洞的新措施。根据这项仍在审查中的新政策，如果东南亚数个国家的数据中心运营商向总部位于中国、俄罗斯和伊朗等少数被视为高风险国家的企业提供“大量算力”，就必须获得许可证才能采购英伟达最先进的芯片。
这些措施延伸了华盛顿限制中国技术发展的举措，既针对中国获取美国先进芯片的能力，也针对其在海外使用这些芯片的能力。
这是英伟达业务面临的最新动荡。在公司首席执行官黄仁勋两周前因被指与新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed的一名高管有染而辞职后，华盛顿方面对中国获取该公司高性能芯片的担忧随之不断扩大。
美国情报官员认为，这位名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的女性在与黄仁勋交往期间曾与中国国家安全部的一名官员有联系。北京方面否认从事间谍活动。本周，在特朗普总统的施压下，公司董事会恢复了黄仁勋的首席执行官职务。
目前尚不清楚此次暂停将持续多久。一名了解暂停情况的人士表示，这是一项权宜之计，直至特朗普政府明确企业如何获得许可证以继续购买芯片。该人士称，美资数据中心运营商似乎不受此次冻结措施的影响，该措施也已扩大至戴尔和超微电脑等将英伟达芯片组装到人工智能服务器上的供应商。
东南亚已成为英伟达利润丰厚的市场，公司已向该地区的数据中心运营商售出价值数十亿美元的芯片。其中许多被称为“新云”(neoclouds)的公司专门向其他客户出租算力。尽管部分公司服务于本地企业，但另一些公司则依赖阿里巴巴、腾讯和字节跳动等中国最大的一些科技公司的需求。
多年来，这种安排使中国企业无需自己拥有芯片，即可使用全球最先进的计算基础设施。
此次销售冻结可能在马来西亚产生尤为广泛的影响，投资者已向该国投入数十亿美元，用于开展全球规模最宏大的数据中心建设计划之一。芯片供应的长期中断可能会使建设和扩张计划陷入停滞，危及投资，并给为这些项目提供融资的放贷机构带来压力。

title: China warns Australia-Philippines defence deal to fuel ‘tensions’
zh_title: 中国警告澳大利亚与菲律宾的防务协议将加剧“紧张局势”
summary: 中国周四谴责澳大利亚和菲律宾之间的一项防务协议，称该协议将“加剧该地区的紧张局势”，该地区存在相互竞争的领土主张，并誓言“捍卫”其权利。菲律宾国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗 (Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.) 和澳大利亚副总理兼国防部长理查德·马勒斯 (Richard Marles) 于 2025 年 8 月举行联合演习。照片：菲律宾武装部队﻿。澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞本月访问菲律宾首都期间，堪培拉和马尼拉之间达成的协议更新了数十年来的协议
content:
中国周四谴责澳大利亚和菲律宾之间的一项防务协议，称该协议将“加剧该地区的紧张局势”，该地区存在相互竞争的领土主张，并誓言“捍卫”其权利。菲律宾国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗 (Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.) 和澳大利亚副总理兼国防部长理查德·马勒斯 (Richard Marles) 于 2025 年 8 月举行联合演习。照片：菲律宾武装部队﻿。堪培拉和马尼拉之间的协议是澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞本月访问菲律宾首都期间达成的，更新了长达数十年的备忘录。近年来，两国稳步加强防务合作，包括在具有重要战略意义的南海进行联合海上巡逻。尽管国际裁决认为北京的主张没有法律依据，但北京对南海的大部分地区拥有主权。美国的盟友菲律宾多年来一直因该航道争议地区与中国发生对抗。另请参阅：中国“爱好和平”，但与菲律宾的对抗可以“轻松取胜”——中国国防部发言人陈曦在周四的新闻发布会上被问及该协议时表示，“菲律宾某些政客出于一己私利，散布对中国的虚假言论，不断进行挑衅、滋事”。
他说，这些人“试图争取域外势力的支持，为自己壮胆，在南海制造事端”。 2019年5月14日，美国海岸警卫队快艇贝索夫号（左）与菲律宾海岸警卫队船只“八打雁”号（中）和“卡朗加曼”号在南海举行演习。照片：美国海岸警卫队，来自 Flickr。 “这只会加剧紧张局势并破坏地区稳定。”陈警告说，如果面临侵犯或挑衅，中国将“采取必要措施坚决回应”，以“坚决挫败任何使南海陷入混乱的企图”。堪培拉表示，澳大利亚和菲律宾之间的防务协议涉及加强海上活动、信息共享和国防基础设施发展等关键要素。

【原文 English Original】
China denounced a defence pact between Australia and the Philippines on Thursday, arguing it would “exacerbate tensions” in a region crisscrossed by competing territorial claims and vowing to “safeguard” its rights. Philippine National Defense Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr. and Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Richard Marles during joint exercises in August 2025. Photo: Armed Forces of the Philippines﻿. The agreement between Canberra and Manila, struck this month during a visit to the Philippine capital by Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, updates a decades-old memorandum. The countries have steadily increased defence cooperation in recent years, including joint maritime patrols in the strategically vital South China Sea. Beijing claims most of the South China Sea despite an international ruling that its assertion has no legal basis. US ally the Philippines has been engaged in years of confrontations with China over disputed areas of the waterway. See also: China ‘loves peace’ but could ‘easily win’ confrontation with Philippines – ambassador “Certain Philippine politicians, driven by their selfish interests, are spreading false narratives about China, constantly engaging in provocations and stirring up trouble,” Chinese defence ministry spokesman Chen Xi told a news conference on Thursday when asked about the deal. Those individuals are “attempting to enlist the backing of forces from outside the region to embolden themselves and create disturbances in the South China Sea”, he said. The US Coast Guard Cutter Bertholf (left) moves in formation with the Philippine Coast Guard vessels Batangas (centre) and Kalanggaman during an exercise on May 14, 2019, in the South China Sea. Photo: US Coast Guard, via Flickr. “This will only exacerbate tensions and undermine regional stability.” If faced with infringements or provocations, China will “take necessary measures to respond firmly”, Chen warned, in order to “resolutely thwart any attempts to plunge the South China Sea into chaos”. The defence deal between Australia and the Philippines involves enhanced maritime activities, sharing of information and defence infrastructure development as key elements, according to Canberra.

title: Linux/EasyShell: MalwareMustDie Identifies One of the Earliest Publicly Documented RATs Built for LoongArch Linux
zh_title: Linux/EasyShell：MalwareMustDie 确定了为 LoongArch Linux 构建的最早公开记录的 RAT 之一
summary: MalwareMustDie 分析 Linux/EasyShell，这是一种针对 Linux 和 macOS 的 Rust 植入程序，具有 LoongArch 支持和隐藏功能以逃避检测。该案例始于受害者节点上发现的 shell 脚本，作者将其归功于 0xrb。 MalwareMustDie 的研究人员首先将其视为又一个中国矿工式卸载程序或下载程序。事实并非如此。该脚本安装软件，它提供的是 Rust 信标植入。 MalwareMustDie 编写了四份逆向工程笔记、一份取证笔记和两份 OSINT 笔记，然后将它们合并为一份报告。这种克制塑造了一切
content:
MalwareMustDie 分析 Linux/EasyShell，这是一种针对 Linux 和 macOS 的 Rust 植入程序，具有 LoongArch 支持和隐藏功能以逃避检测。该案例始于受害者节点上发现的 shell 脚本，作者将其归功于 0xrb。 MalwareMustDie 的研究人员首先将其视为又一个中国矿工式卸载程序或下载程序。事实并非如此。该脚本安装软件，它提供的是 Rust 信标植入。 MalwareMustDie 编写了四份逆向工程笔记、一份取证笔记和两份 OSINT 笔记，然后将它们合并为一份报告。这种克制塑造了接下来的一切。这种谨慎的方法指导着整个分析。 stager 托管在 hxxps://192[.]3.31[.]148:8443 上，并在 Linux 和 macOS 上安装名为 polkitd 的有效负载。在 Linux 上，它保存为 /usr/bin/polkitd，而在 macOS 上，它放置在 ~/Library/Caches/polkitd 中。舞台设计者随机选择八个可能的文件名之一。同一服务器托管恶意软件并通过 TCP 端口 8443 接收其信标通信。它由美国的 ColoCrossing (AS36352) 托管。服务器提供七种不同的版本：l32、l64、l128、a32、a64、darwin_amd64 和 darwin_arm64。研究人员将 Linux x86 版本 l32 描述为基于 Rust 的 HTTPS 信标，其所有必需的库都内置于可执行文件中。其构建路径包含对 EasyShell 框架的引用，包括 easyshell-http-beacon-implant 和 impl-core 等字符串。
因此，研究人员将恶意软件识别为 Linux/EasyShell。 l128 版本针对的是 LoongArch（一种 CPU 架构），并使用 rustc 1.96.0 进行编译，而其他版本则使用 1.95.0。据研究人员称，这是他在公开报告中找到的最早公开记录的 LoongArch64 RAT 实现之一，是在 EasyShell 多平台 Rust 植入家族中发现的。 “我想指出的是，这是我在公开报告中找到的最早公开记录的 LoongArch64 RAT 实现之一（截至 2026 年 11 月 21 日），是在 EasyShell 多平台 Rust 植入家族中发现的。这里的“最早”仅意味着我没有发现更早的公开分析；LoongArch 构建本身是一个框架默认值（第 7 章附录）。”报告指出。 “动手访问：shell、文件盗窃、凭证插件、SOCKS 和中继枢纽 High。没有货币化代码。操作员意图未知 (18.1)。macOS 和 LoongArch 构建是每个 EasyShell stager 提供的框架默认值，而不是该操作员的选择 (18.2)。”有两个警告削弱了有关 LoongArch 针对性活动的任何故事。该报告称，macOS 和 LoongArch 有效负载不是该运营商的选择，因为每个 EasyShell 服务器默认都提供它们。作者还怀疑 LoongArch 版本能否在没有匹配链接或兼容加载器的情况下在 Debian loong64 或 Kylin 主机上加载，并表示它可能从未在真实硬件上进行过测试。作者没有运行任何示例。
该信标是一个到 /api/v2/sync 的 HTTPS POST，带有 X-Client-Id 标头和 Windows Chrome 131 用户代理。根据报告，植入程序可以打开远程 shell、运行插件和脚本、上传和下载文件以及 zip 文件夹。它还提供 SOCKS5 和中继隧道、出站代理、屏幕截图、进程列表和终止以及自删除。凭证转储、令牌提升和浏览器密码盗窃不是内置的。它们来自单独的“扩展”插件集。该植入程序还会检查沙箱，looki

【原文 English Original】
MalwareMustDie analyzes Linux/EasyShell, a Rust implant targeting Linux and macOS, with LoongArch support and stealth features to evade detection. This case began with a shell script found on a victim’s node, which the author credits to 0xrb. MalwareMustDie’s researcher first read it as one more Chinese miner-style uninstaller or downloader. It wasn’t. The script installs software, and what it delivers is a Rust beacon implant. MalwareMustDie wrote four reverse engineering notes, one forensics note, and two OSINT notes, then merged them into one report. That restraint shapes everything that follows. This careful approach guides the entire analysis. The stager is hosted at hxxps://192[.]3.31[.]148:8443 and installs a payload called polkitd on both Linux and macOS. On Linux, it is saved as /usr/bin/polkitd, while on macOS it is placed in ~/Library/Caches/polkitd. The stager randomly chooses one of eight possible file names. The same server hosts the malware and receives its beacon communications over TCP port 8443. It is hosted by ColoCrossing (AS36352) in the United States. The server provides seven different builds: l32, l64, l128, a32, a64, darwin_amd64 and darwin_arm64. The researcher describes the Linux x86 version, l32, as a Rust-based HTTPS beacon with all its required libraries built into the executable. Its build paths contain references to the EasyShell framework, including strings such as easyshell-http-beacon-implant and impl-core. For this reason, the researcher identifies the malware as Linux/EasyShell. The l128 build targets LoongArch, a CPU architecture, and was compiled with rustc 1.96.0, while the others use 1.95.0. According to the researchers, this is one of the earliest publicly documented LoongArch64 RAT implementations he could find in public reporting, identified within the EasyShell multi-platform Rust implant family. “I would like to note that this is one of the earliest publicly documented LoongArch64 RAT implementations I could find in public reporting (as of 2026-11-21), identified within the EasyShell multi-platform Rust implant family. “Earliest” here only means that I found no earlier public analysis; the LoongArch build itself is a framework default ( chapter 7 addendum ).” states the report . “Hands-on access: shell, file theft, credential plugins, SOCKS and relay pivot High. No monetisation code. Operator intent unknown (18.1). The macOS and LoongArch builds are framework defaults offered by every EasyShell stager, not a choice of this operator (18.2).” Two caveats weaken any story about a targeted LoongArch campaign. The report says the macOS and LoongArch payloads aren’t this operator’s choice, because every EasyShell server offers them by default. The author also doubts the LoongArch build would load on a stock Debian loong64 or Kylin host without matching links or a compatible loader, and says it may never have been tested on real hardware. The author didn’t run any sample. The beacon is an HTTPS POST to /api/v2/sync with an X-Client-Id header and a Windows Chrome 131 user agent. According to the report, the implant can open a remote shell, run plugins and scripts, upload and download files, and zip folders. It also offers SOCKS5 and relay tunnels, an outbound proxy, screenshots, process listing and killing, and self-deletion. Credential dumping , token elevation and browser password theft aren’t built in. They come from a separate “Extensions” plugin set. The implant also checks for sandboxes, looking at DMI data, hypervisor names, mouse activity and system resources. Then it renames itself like a kernel thread, for example [kworker/0:0]. A third-party Joe Sandbox run on November 21 gives a useful reality check. It executed another l32 copy on Ubuntu 20.04 for about five minutes. The copy had the same size, 3,769,372 bytes, but a different hash, and it made three TCP connections to the C2, forked a child that called prctl, uname and a thread sleep, and created an empty hidden file. The score was 2 out of 100 with no YARA or Suricata match, which says more about the malware waiting for someone else to show up than about its harmlessness. That hash difference matters. The server writes random bytes into one slot of every payload it generates, so each victim gets a different file. “YARA family rule MMD_Linux_EasyShell_Rust_Implant on memory dumps and new binaries (it still matches the builds without the crate name); do not rely on the hashes for other victims.” MalwareMustDie warns. The first draft of the report dates from November 19, and an addendum on November 22 documented the per-download hashes and the developer repository. On attribution, the author is careful. EasyShell is a Chinese red team C2 framework sold through trial and member programs, and its public repository matches the samples. It isn’t VShell and has no Kinsing or SystemTen link, although the stager is based on a VShell template. No operator is named, and the author says the tool’s build markers describe its build environment, not whoever runs this C2. There’s one loose thread. A separate chapter describes an intrusion on a Chinese mobile-malware hosting server, and a single shell-history line there re-ran the EasyShell stager from the same C2. The author rates the link between the two operators as medium confidence. A note about a December 2025 incident that used the same stager template at a different IP is marked unverified. For security teams, the l32 version does not have its own way to remain on an infected system, although its plugins may add this feature. The researcher suggests looking for processes that use names normally associated with kernel threads, such as [kworker/0:0] or [rcu_sched], but have a real executable file listed under /proc/pid/exe. Another warning sign is HTTPS POST traffic to /api/v2/sync with an X-Client-Id header. On macOS, defenders should look for executable files in user Caches folders that lack a quarantine attribute, code signatures without a Team ID, and security permission requests (TCC prompts) that mention polkitd. The report also includes YARA, Sigma and osquery detection rules. The researcher recommends starting in detection-only mode. These rules were tested against known malware strings, but not against a large collection of legitimate software to check for false positives. If a system looks infected, there is one important rule: do not kill the fake kernel thread immediately. The researcher recommends first isolating and preserving the system before terminating any process. The report ships YARA, Sigma and osquery rules, meant to start in detect-only mode. They were checked on strings, not through a full retro-hunt on legitimate software. “Golden rule: do not kill the fake kernel thread first. Collect its process state and memory, freeze it, cut its network, then clean. Killing it first loses the live config, the session keys and the tunnel table.” concludes the report. title: Beijing slams US for ‘suppressing’ Chinese firms after Huawei conviction

summary: 周三，在美国陪审团裁定科技巨头华为窃取商业机密并就其在伊朗的工作向监管机构撒谎后，北京猛烈抨击美国“打压”中国企业。华为总部位于深圳。照片：华为。全球领先的电信设备制造商华为已成为唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的攻击目标，经过三个月的审判后，华为于周二在纽约联邦法院被定罪。这项裁决是在美国和中国的政治敏感时刻作出的，两国领导人试图表达特朗普所说的“f
content:
周三，在美国陪审团裁定科技巨头华为窃取商业机密并就其在伊朗的工作向监管机构撒谎后，北京猛烈抨击美国“打压”中国企业。华为总部位于深圳。照片：华为。全球领先的电信设备制造商华为已成为唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的攻击目标，经过三个月的审判后，华为于周二在纽约联邦法院被定罪。这项裁决是在美国和中国的政治敏感时期做出的，两国领导人上周在深圳会晤时试图展现特朗普所说的“奇妙”关系。陪审团裁定华为面临 12 项刑事罪名中的 10 项罪名成立，包括银行欺诈、合谋窃取商业机密以及合谋诈骗美国。中国周三予以回击，称“坚决反对美国打压和围堵中国企业，坚定支持中国企业维护合法权益”。特朗普政府长期以来一直声称华为存在代表中国政府从事间谍活动的风险，并此前敦促各国不要在新的 5G 移动网络中使用该公司的基础设施。 “没有任何人或公司可以凌驾于法律之上，”美国司法部长托德·布兰奇在定罪后的一份声明中表示。
“几十年来，华为及其三个子公司在美国以谎言和盗窃为基础开展业务。”美国和中国国旗。资料图片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。华为周三驳回了这一判决，并在一份声明中表示，该判决“没有法律或事实依据”。 “我们将彻底审查相关判决，并采取一切必要的法律行动来捍卫我们的权益，”它补充道。 “必要的法律行动”然而，陪审团确实宣判华为无罪，该公司表示，此举“欢迎”，并补充说，它“证实了这些指控缺乏事实依据，并证明了我们在过去八年中的一贯立场。” “我们认为政府的其余指控同样没有法律或事实依据……我们将彻底审查相关判决，并采取一切必要的法律行动来捍卫我们的权益，”声明继续说道。这些指控部分涉及华为与伊朗政府的业务往来。美国司法部表示：“华为多次对其在伊朗业务的性质撒谎，错误地告诉银行、记者和美国政府，它没有协助伊朗政府、军队或情报部门。”
“华为向银行谎报其在伊朗的活动，以获得数十亿美元并获得美元清算服务，这使华为成为全球电信服务市场的成熟参与者——部分原因是它的谎言。”这家设备制造商还被指控试图招募美国电信公司的员工，并在此过程中从他们那里获取技术信息。根据最初的起诉书，这些数据据称使华为能够开发与其竞争对手类似的产品，然后以较低的价格出售。资料图片：维基百科。美国司法部在一份新闻稿中表示：“被盗用的知识产权包括商业秘密信息和受版权保护的作品，例如互联网路由器的源代码和用户手册、天线技术和机器人测试技术。”华为甚至还推出了一款inter

Beijing lashed out at the United States on Wednesday for “suppressing” Chinese companies, after a US jury found tech giant Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and lying to regulators over its work in Iran. Huawei headquarters in Shenzhen. Photo: Huawei. Huawei, the world’s leading telecom equipment manufacturer, has been targeted by President Donald Trump’s administration, and was convicted on Tuesday in a New York federal court after a three-month trial. The ruling comes at a politically sensitive time for the United States and China, whose leaders sought to project what Trump called a “fantastic” relationship when they met in Shenzhen last week. Jurors found Huawei guilty of 10 of the 12 criminal counts facing it — including bank fraud, conspiracy to steal trade secrets and conspiracy to defraud the United States. China hit back on Wednesday, saying it “firmly opposes the US suppressing and containing Chinese enterprises and firmly supports Chinese enterprises in safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests.” Trump’s administration has long alleged a risk of Huawei spying on behalf of the Chinese government, and previously urged countries not to use the company’s infrastructure in new 5G mobile networks. “No person or company is above the law,” US Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a statement after the conviction. “For decades, Huawei and three of its subsidiaries conducted their business in the United States on the basis of lies and theft.” The US and Chinese flag. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. Huawei rejected the conviction on Wednesday, saying in a statement it was “without legal or factual merit.” “We will thoroughly review the relevant verdicts and take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests,” it added. ‘Necessary legal actions’ The jury did, however, acquit Huawei of racketeering conspiracy and obstruction of justice, a move the company said it “welcomed,” adding that it “confirms that these allegations lack factual basis and vindicates our consistent position over the past eight years.” “We believe the government’s remaining charges are equally without legal or factual merit… We will thoroughly review the relevant verdicts and take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests,” the statement continued. The charges in part involved Huawei’s business dealings with the government of Iran. “Huawei repeatedly lied about the nature of its business in Iran, falsely telling banks, journalists, and the US government that it did not assist Iran’s government, military, or intelligence community,” the DOJ said. “Huawei lied about its activities in Iran to banks to obtain billions of US dollars and access to US-dollar clearing services, which enabled Huawei to be a sophisticated participant in a global marketplace for telecommunications services — in part because of its lies.” The equipment manufacturer was also accused of attempting to recruit employees of US telecoms firms and obtaining technological information from them in the process. That data allegedly enabled Huawei to develop products similar to those of its competitors, which it then sold at lower prices, according to the original indictment. File photo: Wikipedia. “The misappropriated intellectual property included trade secret information and copyrighted works, such as source code and user manuals for internet routers, antenna technology, and robot testing technology,” the DOJ said in a release. Huawei even launched an internal program offering bonuses to employees who obtained industrial secrets from competitors, prosecutors claimed. “Today’s verdict sends an unmistakable message: America will defend its businesses, protect its workers, and safeguard its national security against corrupt foreign corporations that lie, cheat, and steal to get ahead,” Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva said in a statement.

title: 中大擬修例「損校譽」可撤學位、踢出校 校友：以畢業後行為「搣柴」有「秋後算帳」之嫌

content: 追光者報道 民建聯陳恒鑌、工聯會鄧家彪等4名中大立法會議員校董，提交《2026年香港中文大學(修訂)條例草案》，當中最爭議是賦權教務會可基於「違反道德或專業操守、刑事定罪或行為有損香港中文大學聲譽等原因」撤銷校友學位。有中大畢業的前立法會議員質疑條文定義過於闊寬，有「秋後算帳」涉及反修例或其他政治案件之嫌，認為校方的「手」不應「長到人哋畢業30年後仲可以DQ」學位。 立法會教育事務委員會將於下周五（4日）初步討論中大校董會提交的《修例草案》，校董會稱修例是為了「配合國家發展大局及中大未來發展需要」，並指有關方案已獲「持份者廣泛支持」。然而，《草案》交上立法會後卻引起校友議論紛紛，當中最令人關注就是修訂撤銷學位及學籍的機制。 違道德、有案底、損校譽「等」均成DQ理由 校友單仲偕：學校不應管校友畢業後行為 據修訂條文顯示，教務會可因「例如學術不端、偽造學歷、違反道德或專業操守、刑事定罪或行為有損香港中文大學聲譽等原因」，撤銷任何人的中大學位、文憑、證書或其他資格頒授，並以同等理由「對學生施加任何處分」，包括暫停或開除學籍。 至於教務會則由校長、副校長、書院院長、課程單位主任、教務人員等組成；教務會中原有學生會會長及各書院民選學生代表席位在這次修例被改成「按教務會決定的方式互選產生」及委任的一名學生代表，以及兩名學生校董代表。 中大碩士畢業的前立法會議員單仲偕向《追光者》表示，對於修例向已畢業多年的校友「搣柴」感到不解，他認為若該人在學時期犯法而開除學籍，做法亦算合理；但若校友已經畢業多年後，單仲偕覺得「已經同你學校無乜關係」，學校的「手」不應「長到人哋畢業30年後仲可以DQ」學位。 定義過於寛闊「乜都包」 憂校方日後「選擇性執法」 他又批評，修例中羅列的「搣柴」依據都過於寬鬆。單仲偕提到，即使區議員被定罪，法例亦訂明刑期須超過3個月才能革職，但這次修例卻未有為「刑事定罪」界定時間範圍，有可能導致「秋後算帳」的情況出現，特別是針對2019年反修例、初選案或其他政治檢控，甚至被通緝的中大校友。 單仲偕亦指，條文中的「有損中大聲譽」已經相當主觀，「萬佛朝宗乜都包」，而且還要加入「例如」和「等」的字眼，涵蓋的範圍過為寬闊，「引人不必要的猜測」。他笑言，條例通過後，難保中大也可能「搣佢柴」。 單仲偕亦擔心修例通過後，教務會可能「選擇性執法」。翻查資料，中大今年2月便以「有損中大校譽」為由，開除關靖豐學籍，他曾為宏福苑大火發起聯署，要求政府問責，並因此被國安處拘捕。不過事隔半年多，中大畢業的新亞書院副院長莊太量卻在新亞周會上發表「釣金龜」等歧視女性言論，並引起社會各界批評，但校方至今未有紀律調查或處分。 過去多名政界人物、高官涉刑事罪行或醜聞 儘管近年多宗政治案件均有中大校友涉案，但過去亦有多名中大畢業的政界人物亦曾牽涉刑事罪行或政治醜聞，例如前經濟發展及勞工局副秘書長馮永業，於任內因收受利益而被裁定「公職人員行為失當」罪成，入獄9個月。現任財政司司長陳茂波，在2012年擔任發展局局長期間，亦被揭發曾違法經營劏房，並在政府推動新界東北發展計劃期間，以公司名義持有新界東北的大量地土地，當時同樣引起社會各界的猛烈批評。這些案例會否在修例通過後，會否成為褫奪學位範例，仍然是未知之數。

content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 24 日，本网获悉：江苏张家港维权女士陶红已被当局非法拘禁近四年。 2025 年 4 月 28 日，江苏省张家港市人民检察院对陶红作出不予起诉决定，陶红随即获释，但只获自由一天， 4 月 29 日陶红又被张家港市公安局毫无理由地非法拘禁在陶红曾多次长期被禁锢的过渡房内，这个过渡房位于张家港市人民检察院西侧南北向道路的北端，距张家港市检察院直线距离不足 100 米。 陶红已经被中共张家港当局非法剥夺人身自由 4 年多。 2022 年 9 月 9 日，陶红在北京被张家港公安截回，经过被“隔离”、关宾馆非法拘禁后， 9 月 22 日被张家港市公安局以涉嫌寻衅滋事罪作出取保候审决定，然后被押到张家港市杨舍镇范庄村老年过渡房执行取保候审，禁止其离开过渡房，由派出所、街道和保安公司人员 24 小时堵门看守，失去人身自由。 2022 年 9 月 29 日，陶红趁看守不备，逃出到本市亲戚家， 9 月 30 日， 30 多名公安冲到陶红亲戚家进行搜查，把陶红带走，然后传唤陶红亲戚。 2022 年 10 月 1 日，陶红被刑事拘留到苏州市第四看守所， 10 月 31 日又被押回老年过渡房执行《监视居住决定》六个月。 2023 年 5 月 1 日，又变更为取保候审，仍被剥夺人身自由和通讯自由，仍然被控制在过度房内，有时偶尔可以到院子里，但不能出院子。 2024 年 4 月 29 日，办案民警王辰告知案件已经移送市检察院， 4 月 30 日，王辰和检察官过来告知由检察院对其采取取保候审，还是将陶红非法拘禁在过渡房内，不让外人接触，不让陶红与外界联系，剥夺陶红的法定诉讼权利。 2025 年 4 月 28 日，张家港市检察院对陶红作出不予起诉决定，但陶红仅仅获释一天，就于 4 月 30 日被张家港市公安局非法剥夺人身自由，仍将陶红非法关押在过渡房内，张家港市公安局在过渡房门前搭建了临时房， 24 小时有 4 人看守，还把过渡房的后窗户也给封死，彻底堵死了所有通道。 据张家港其他维权人透露，现在没有任何人能见到陶红，外人只要一进过渡房的院内，那些看守人员就马上警觉上前询问，发现异常就立即报警派出所，派出所马上就出警拦截，甚至传唤前往人员。陶红母亲曾一度可以给陶红送饭，但后来也被拒绝了，其母亲既伤心，又无奈，说陶红身患重病，警察不给治，后来做了手术，还不让住院治疗，现无人能见到陶红，生死不明。 张家港维权朋友就在近期，曾试图进入陶红所在过渡房的院内，发现仍有看守在临时房内，发现有人进入院内立即警惕并上前询问，证实了陶红仍被非法拘禁在此地。 陶红年近八旬母亲哭红了眼睛，无奈地诉说着对女儿的牵挂与痛心，但却无济于事，张家港维权朋友也无能为力，因此他们知道，在黑恶公权面前，他们就是一只小蝼蚁，曾经也试图前往营救，都被公安传唤关押恐吓、威胁、警告，他们恳请网友及国际人权组织关注，揭露张家港当局非法拘禁陶红的罪行，营救陶红，否则，陶红的下场，就与无锡江阴毛黎惠一样，最终被黑恶公权灭口。

title: 江苏无锡锡山区云林街道对赵振海的房屋实施司法强拆
summary: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 24 日，本网获悉：江苏无锡锡山区云林街道对赵振海的房屋实施司法强拆。 2026 年 11 月 23 日上午 9 时许，江苏省无锡市锡山区云林街道组织公安、城管、铲车、挖机、 120 救护等部门，将赵振海位于云林街道双桥村赵巷上 90 号的合法房屋强制拆除。 2026 年 11 月 20 日（周五），赵振海收到了无锡市锡山区人民法院 11 月 18 日作出的（ 2026 ）苏 0205 行审 12 号行政裁定书，裁定：准予强制执
content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 24 日，本网获悉：江苏无锡锡山区云林街道对赵振海的房屋实施司法强拆。 2026 年 11 月 23 日上午 9 时许，江苏省无锡市锡山区云林街道组织公安、城管、铲车、挖机、 120 救护等部门，将赵振海位于云林街道双桥村赵巷上 90 号的合法房屋强制拆除。 2026 年 11 月 20 日（周五），赵振海收到了无锡市锡山区人民法院 11 月 18 日作出的（ 2026 ）苏 0205 行审 12 号行政裁定书，裁定：准予强制执行无锡市锡山区人民政府云林街道办事处作出的《关于履行行政协议义务的行政处理决定书》，由无锡市锡山区人民政府云林街道办事处组织实施。 2026 年 11 月 23 日（周一）上午，云林街道就急切地实施强制拆除，未依《行政强制法》的规定保障赵振海的相关权益。 当天上午 8 时许，赵振海房屋四周就被公安和城管实施警戒，禁止外人进入，然后，公安对赵振海房屋内的人员实施传唤带离，再由街道对房屋内物品进行清空，最后，铲车和挖机将赵振海房屋推倒铲平。 这是中共无锡实施的第一起经法院裁定准予执行强制拆除的征地拆迁案，也是中共无锡利用公权抢劫老百姓房屋和土地实施黑恶拆迁的罪证。 据赵振海反映， 2023 年 7 月 13 日云林街道双桥村委以欺诈和哄骗的手段，诱骗其在空白《宅基地住宅置换房屋补偿安置协议》上签字，并口头承诺了一些条件，可赵振海签字后，村委出尔反尔，拒不兑现承诺，为此，赵振海不认可协议，不按协议腾空搬离，并向法院提起诉讼，请求法院确认协议违法。锡山区云林街道成为被告并出示了其 2023 年 2 月 6 日与双桥村委签订的《委托合同》，以证明双桥村委系受其委托与赵振海签订了协议。 无锡市滨湖区法院作出一审判决，确认双桥村委与赵振海签订的《宅基地住宅置换房屋补偿安置协议》合法，赵振海不服该判决，上诉至无锡市中级人民法院，又遭枉法维持。随后，云林街道作出的《关于履行行政协议义务的行政处理决定书》，要求赵振海履行协议约定，经催告后，向锡山区法院申请强制执行该决定书，在强制执行案听证过程中，赵振海将执行异议及案外人执行异议等情况详细向法庭作了陈述，但法庭却一概不理，立即作出准予执行裁定。 本案最大、最明显的，也是代理律师刻意为被告掩盖的违法之处，是案涉拆迁安置协议严重程序倒置，自始无效！ 锡山区政府的案涉地块集体土地的征地拆迁预公告是 2023 年 11 月 21 日才发布，而双桥村委却在 2023 年 7 月 13 日就哄骗赵振海签订了案涉征地拆迁协议，云林街道却提供了其 2023 年 2 月 6 日就已经与双桥村委签订的《委托合同》，也就是说，双桥村委哄骗赵振海签订案涉征地拆迁协议时，锡山区政府还未启动该地块的拆迁征地程序，云林街道和双桥村委的行为，严重违反了《土地管理法》及其实施条例规定的征地程序，导致案涉拆迁安置协议成无源之水，无根之木，但，无锡二级法院都枉法维持了该一目了然的违法协议，云林街道更是违反《行政强制法》关于强制拆除程序的规定，迫不及待地对赵振海的住宅实施了强制拆除，而代理律师却对上述违法行为一概不提。 本案另一重大违法之处，是将案外人赵振海母亲赵末仙的祖产，即赵末仙父亲赵坤全的房屋，也纳入赵振海的强制执行范围，一并给摧毁了。 91 岁的赵末仙被云林街道安排在医院，目前状况不详。 赵振海说：“共产党已经是土匪强盗了，不讲理不讲法，把我的合法财产就这样给抢了，还让老百姓活吗？我母亲的祖产已经跟法院讲清楚了，法院仍然枉法判决，帮政府抢劫，我真想不通，现在的共产党已经黑恶到这种程度。” 附： 1 、行政裁定书； 2 、赵末仙的祖产凭证。

content:
保护西藏环境。保护我们共同的未来。西藏的河流养活了数百万人。谁来保护他们的来源？西藏是亚洲一些最重要河流的源头。它的冰川、雪地和水道为下游约 14 亿人口提供了生存保障。然而，这一至关重要的环境正面临着越来越大的威胁。 2026年，尼藏边境发生的一场灾难，引发了国际社会对西藏面临的环境风险的关注。这是一个鲜明的提醒：西藏环境发生的变化所产生的后果远远超出了西藏的边界。我们要保护西藏的环境。我们需要保护我们共同的未来。十多年来，澳大利亚西藏理事会和世界各地的西藏团体一直对西藏冰川加速融化和环境破坏发出警报。气候变化正在加速冰川融化，增加洪水和其他环境灾害的风险。与此同时，中国无节制的大规模采矿、水坝建设、引水和其他大型开发项目正在改变西藏的景观和水道。澳大利亚西藏委员会正在争取全球暂停西藏的采矿和大型开发。我们呼吁停止这些项目，直到藏人能够自由决定他们的土地会发生什么，并且可以表示同意或拒绝同意，而不必担心被捕、监禁或酷刑。这不仅仅是一场环保运动。
这是一项争取西藏人民权利的运动，旨在保护他们的土地、河流和他们的未来。 呼吁捐款表 如果您希望通过直接存款的方式捐款，请参阅下面的银行详细信息： 账户名称：澳大利亚西藏委员会 BSB：063 147 帐号：1001 0643 请务必在参考资料中注明“EOYA26”和您的姓名 通过向澳大利亚西藏委员会的年终呼吁捐款，您将帮助我们：按澳大利亚西藏委员会政府对西藏发生的环境破坏采取更强硬的立场。增加国际社会对全球暂停西藏采矿和大型开发项目的支持。要求科学家、研究人员、记者和人道主义组织独立进入西藏。提高藏人为他们的环境发声的声音。几个世纪以来，西藏人民一直在管理着喜马拉雅山这一独特的环境，但他们对这里发生的事情没有任何有意义的发言权。西藏处于中国的占领之下。我们相信西藏人民有权保护他们的环境免受中国采矿、筑坝和大型开发项目造成的破坏。他们的权利必须得到尊重，决不能将可能产生不可逆转后果的决定强加给他们。请支持我们保护西藏独特环境的工作。尼泊尔-西藏灾难提醒世界，西藏的环境未来并不是一个遥远或孤立的问题。
河流、冰川和生态系统的健康关系到亚洲数以百万计的人民以及我们共同的未来。但保护西藏的环境必须从承认西藏人民的权利开始。他们必须有保护自己土地并决定其未来的自由。请立即向澳大利亚西藏委员会的年终呼吁捐款。您的贡献将有助于将西藏的环境问题保留在国际议程上，加强我们的全球暂停行动，并使各国政府对使其面临风险的决定负责。齐心协力，我们就能站稳脚跟

Protect Tibet’s environment. Protect our shared future. Tibet’s rivers sustain millions. Who will protect their source? Tibet is the source of some of Asia’s most important rivers. Its glaciers, snowfields and waterways sustain approximately 1.4 billion people downstream. Yet this vital environment is under growing threat. In 2026, a disaster along the Nepal-Tibet border brought international attention to the environmental risks facing Tibet. It was a stark reminder that what happens to Tibet’s environment has consequences far beyond its borders. We need to protect Tibet’s environment. We need to protect our shared future. For more than a decade, Australia Tibet Council and Tibet groups around the world have been sounding the alarm about the accelerating glacial melt and environmental destruction taking place in Tibet. Climate change is accelerating glacial melt and increasing the risk of floods and other environmental disasters. At the same time, China's unchecked large-scale mining, dam construction, water diversion and other mega-development projects are transforming Tibet’s landscape and waterways. Australia Tibet Council is campaigning for a global moratorium on mining and mega-development in Tibet. We are calling for these projects to stop until Tibetans can freely decide what happens to their land and can give or refuse their consent without fear of arrest, imprisonment or torture. This is not simply an environmental campaign. It is a campaign for the rights of the Tibetan people to protect their land, their rivers and their future. Grow international support for a global moratorium on mining and mega-development projects in Tibet. Demand independent access to Tibet for scientists, researchers, journalists and humanitarian organisations. Raise the voices of Tibetans speaking up for their environment. Tibetan people, who have stewarded this unique Himalayan environment for centuries, have no meaningful say in what happens to it. Tibet is under Chinese occupation. We believe the Tibetan people have the right to protect their environment from the destruction caused by China's mining, damming and mega-development projects. Their rights must be respected, and decisions with potentially irreversible consequences must never be imposed on them. Please support our work to help protect Tibet's unique environment. The Nepal-Tibet disaster reminded the world that Tibet’s environmental future is not a distant or isolated concern. The health of its rivers, glaciers and ecosystems matters to millions of people across Asia and to the future we all share. But protecting Tibet’s environment must begin with recognising the rights of the Tibetan people. They must have the freedom to protect their own land and determine its future. Please donate to Australia Tibet Council’s End of Year Appeal today. Your contribution will help keep Tibet’s environment on the international agenda, strengthen our campaign for a global moratorium and hold governments accountable for the decisions that put it at risk. Together, we can stand with the Tibetan people and defend their right to protect their land and their future.

content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 22 日，本网获悉： 2026 年 11 月 21 日，是获刑 3 年 6 个月的北京民间出版人涂金灿被捕三周年。 涂金灿先生长期从事民间家谱、家史及个人传记出版工作。 1989 年，他曾因撰写《中国何处去》被关押一年，也是《零八宪章》签署人。 2023 年 11 月 21 日，被羁押。 2026 年 3 月 24 日，被以“非法经营罪”判刑 3 年 6 个月。 涂金灿简介： 1962 年出生于湖北省孝感市，曾做过教师，后进行文化创业。 2008 年，涂金灿在北京创办“家谱传记机构”，从事民间家谱、家史、传记的出书业务，至 2023 年 11 月 21 日被捕的 15 年间 , 已经为 5000 多个普通百姓家庭整理出版了家谱、家史、个人传记类图书。他的事迹曾被新华社、《中国青年报》、《中国日报海外版》等官方媒体做过专题报道。 2015 年 5 月，时任总理李克强到海淀区创业大街视察，还曾参观过涂金灿的“北京家谱传记文化馆”。 2020 年至 2022 年的三年疫情封控期间，涂金灿的民间出书业务遭到重大打击，仅靠借债勉强维持运作。 2023 年疫情封控解除后，本以为业务能得到一些恢复，但当局的文化管制和经济勒索接踵而来。在被捕前，涂金灿已多次被海淀区文化部门、公安部门约谈，被海淀区公安局及中关村派出所查封图书仓库，公司承接的一部《何氏家谱》图书在邮寄发货后被海关查扣，以此为由进行罚款，但经过三年疫情，涂金灿及其公司已经债务累累，公司日常运作已经非常困难，根本没钱交纳罚款。当局的经济勒索没达到目的，就悍然动用司法手段，以刑事罪名抓捕了涂金灿，查封了“北京家谱传记机构”，导致公司停业员工失业。 2026 年 3 月 24 日，涂金灿被控“非法经营”案，经过近两年半的超期羁押，终被中共北京市海淀区法院以“非法经营”罪名判刑 3 年 6 个月；刑期： 2023 年 11 月 21 日至 2027 年 5 月 20 日。目前被关押在北京海淀区看守所（苏家陀镇温阳路 25 号） 808 室，看守所的邮编： 100194 ；电话： 010 ～ 82587233 。

title: 蘇暁康：大规模群众运动

content: 作者臉書 2026-11-22 【按：昨天（２１/１１）在六四博物館舉辦《六十後反思文革》討論會，我帶著傅莉去參加，我在上面講，她就坐在下面聽；我準備了一個發言稿，想把這個題目講得寬泛一些，尤其希望把文革和八九兩場運動比較一下，我也認為，未來必定會有第三場「大规模群众运动」發生，卻不能斷定其後果，是導致更大的社會崩潰，還是良性的憲政建制。】 1989年的天安门学运，跟1976年结束的文革，两者之间只相隔十三年，等于在很短的时间里，几乎是同一个世代，中国发生了两次全国规模的群众运动，这个现象，无论在政治、社会、文化和思想史诸方面，都具有极大的意义。 更重要的一点是，由于民间共同记忆的催发，对于文革的研究，已经产生了不少论述、观点、争辩和反思，但是“六四”事件的发生，无疑将对人们关于文革的共同记忆发生影响，甚至是颠覆性的影响，原因有两个：一是八九学运有意无意间在模仿文革，或者说，文革中的许多行为模式、思想方法，不可遏制地遗传到八九学运中来；二是，中共当局最初定性学运和最终选择调野战军进京镇压的决策，其潜意识都是来自于他们的“文革经验”。 第一場是毛澤東琦理斯瑪（ｃｈａｒｉｓｍａ）地親自發動文革，血腥、暴力、內戰，億萬中國人完全是群氓般的聽從指揮，鑄成現代史上一場奇觀，至今被西方左派奉為「人民革命」的經典； 第二場則是人民（學生打先鋒）上街、靜坐、絕食，抗議體制（官場）腐敗，卻遭到被毛澤東偶然放生存活之鄧小平的血腥鎮壓，有趣的是，鄧恰是把八九學生視為「紅衛兵造反派」，他的文革經驗可能正是其殺人動機。 还有一个更现实的背景是，“六四”镇压后，中共建构刚性“维稳”系统，返回“全能主义”控制，不惜一切代价压制民间的任何意愿，并成功达至低人权、低福利、高污染、高腐败的“经济起飞”，得以配合大资本跨国公司完成“全球化”，由此中共塑造了一种与时代潮流相悖的“中国模式”，虽然这二十年间国际社会接连发生了“苏东波”共产体制坍塌、中东“茉莉花”民间抗议风潮两大成功的“公民抗命”运动；这意味着中国的经验解构了西方关于“经济发展必定促进政治进步”的预期，提供了关于“公民抗命”的相反实践。中国在一个极短促历史中的两次“大规模群众运动”，竟然走向彻底相反的结论，这是非常讽刺的。 上述这些富有挑战性的问题，都指向一个可能的解答途径，那就是文革与“八九”两大运动的比较性研究，特别是它们之间的相关性。文革因其全方位搅动政治、社会、文化、思想等几乎所有领域，已经在中国形成了有别于传统文化（旧传统）、共产党文化（新传统）的一个“新近传统”，我们特别需要解析这个传统。 一、造反派的“文革传统” 1、“学生闹事”：五四的承传与变异 2、市民、工人的后援与掉链 3、 「人民文革」說 4、還有一個「八一八」話題，未必只是一個文革話題，也不僅僅是「紅二代」話題，而是一個集權題目，最明顯的證據，就是習近平是一個「黑五類」，卻拿到權力也搞文革，他受迫害的教訓，是去迫害更多的人；而中共的「我們子弟接班」，極有深意地選「落難子弟」而不選正統紅衛兵，連薄熙來也跟習一樣的經歷，其中奧妙何在？可惜中國沒有言論自由，展開不了這個題目。 二、走资派“后文革”行为的遗产 1、报复模式与体制的恐惧——１９７０年的「一打三反」和六四屠殺； 2、“维稳系统”、雲集權、監控社會 三、毛的“文革遗产” 1、“造反有理”是一笔什么遗产？ 2、 「奇里斯瑪」現象 四、“文革”和“八九“對未来的意义 1、对未来“公民社会”建构的效应 2、對中國政治轉型的影響

title: 曾被看好是“习接班人” 陈吉宁早有危险信号

content: 2024年4月25日，美国国务卿布林肯在上海与上海市委书记陈吉宁会谈。 (Mark Schiefelbein/POOL/AFP via Getty Images) 【大纪元2026年11月24日讯】在涉及高层换届的中共二十一大前，中共内斗激烈。最新一个落马的陈吉宁，此前曾是新一届政治局常委预测名单中的热门人选。不过早前已有分析认为，陈吉宁被看好作为习的接班人，恰恰犯忌，必然带来危险。 中央政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁11月24日被宣布落马。 1964年2月出生的陈吉宁，早前出现在海外网络流传的多份二十一届政治局常委预测名单中。不过，独立评论人杜政5月份在台媒《上报》文章中，指出陈吉宁的危险信号。 杜政表示，现在高层中相对年轻的技术官僚、上海市委书记陈吉宁，可能入不了常，也相信是由于接班传言犯忌。 陈吉宁2024年11月28日会见了新加坡国务资政李显龙。新加坡《联合早报》发布的影片显示，李显龙离开中国前在上海接受新媒联访，他说希望与中国下一代领导人们建立新的联系。媒体报导画面这时带到中共政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁。之后，海外开始热议：陈吉宁有望成习的接班人？ 杜政文章指出，这等于害了陈吉宁，之前孙政才、胡春华和陈敏尔都因接班人的名号倒台或被边缘化。 1960年生的陈敏尔，作为是习家军的重要代表，2019年被到访重庆的时任新加坡副总理兼财政部长王瑞杰，点名为中共“下一代领导人”。 王瑞杰当时被外界认为是时任新加坡总理李显龙的接班人。他和陈敏尔的对话引发关注。据官方报导，王瑞杰说，希望此次会议能为我们（两国）下一代领导人铺路。陈敏尔则回应说，通过此次会议，他深刻体会到两国政治高层的意图及合作方针。有台湾红媒报导的标题干脆就用了“中星（新）下一代领导人重庆首会面”。 杜政表示，这样的高调定位“下一代领导人”在中共官场显然是犯忌的。结果，被吹捧到得意忘形的陈敏尔，到二十大平调到地位不比重庆重要的天津，没能升任政治局常委。陈敏尔在天津政绩平平，他当年在贵州的旧部最近频频出事，不太可能还有机会接班。 杜政认为。习想终生掌权，不想有接班人窥伺最高权位。习年纪越大越多疑，现在对“熟人”都要防范，何况那些有野心争取接班的新人？有陈敏尔的前车之鉴，陈吉宁被看好可能是习接班人，并非好事，除了习近平会收到传言，习家军的其他人也会马上盯紧陈吉宁。

title: Trump’s Incoherent Tariffs
zh_title: 特朗普不连贯的关税
summary: 在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。当美国还沉浸在英伟达丑闻和特朗普向中国出卖国家安全的腐败行为中时，在银河系的另一个地方，特朗普的首席贸易官员杰米森·格里尔(Jamieson Greer)宣布对中国征收高达45%的新一轮关税，作为对造成产能过剩的政策的报复。在特朗普世界里，一只手常常不知道另一只手在做什么。但即使对特朗普来说，这种政策脱节也是极端的。这些关税与 T 所采取的完全非法的关税不同
content:
在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。当美国还沉浸在英伟达丑闻和特朗普向中国出卖国家安全的腐败行为中时，在银河系的另一个地方，特朗普的首席贸易官员杰米森·格里尔(Jamieson Greer)宣布对中国征收高达45%的新一轮关税，作为对造成产能过剩的政策的报复。在特朗普世界里，一只手常常不知道另一只手在做什么。但即使对特朗普来说，这种政策脱节也是极端的。这些关税与特朗普一时兴起征收的完全非法关税不同，至少遵循国内法。它们是美国贸易代表办公室调查的结果。 《贸易法》第 301 条探讨了全球产能过剩的根源。 Today on TAP 这个故事首次出现在我们的免费 Today on TAP 时事​​通讯中，这是一封工作日电子邮件，其中包含来自 Prospect 记者的每日新闻评论。注册 没有付费专区，没有程序化广告——只有报告。随时取消订阅。提交您的电子邮件即表示您已注册参加我们工作日下午的新闻通讯 Today on TAP。正常的政府将依赖其多样化外交政策杠杆和目标的联系。如果你不想我们提高关税，就停止扣留稀土矿出口；或停止威胁台湾；或者停止在出口管制方面作弊并设计诡计进口更先进的芯片。
一个一致的政府还可能将贸易政策与国内产业政策联系起来。提高针对掠夺性贸易政策的关税，以便美国能够重建太阳能电池等领域的技术和生产能力。但特朗普可不是这么想的。在他混乱的大脑的某一部分，他知道自己喜欢关税。所以让我们再次提出它们。在他支离破碎的心灵的另一部分，特朗普将英伟达视为他自己和他的亲信的个人利润来源。所以一切都被原谅了。对特朗普来说，联系意味着将他的个人财富与放弃出口管制联系起来，而不是关税和产业政策之间的战略联系。因此，格里尔的关税计划是自动运行的，特朗普只注意到标题：关税好！还有一个细节。格里尔不属于特朗普的核心圈子，他向商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克汇报。在中国/英伟达方面，卢特尼克的主要贡献是在出口管制方面制造新的漏洞，以促进表面上被禁止的高端芯片的销售。卢特尼克甚至关注关税吗？你可以想象格里尔向卢特尼克展示他的发现和计划，而卢特尼克回答说：“当然，无论如何。”讽刺的是，格里尔是特朗普政府中为数不多的有能力的人之一。特朗普一时兴起非法提高关税，削弱了美国贸易代表办公室的使命，直到这些非法举动被最高法院阻止。姗姗来迟，国务卿。 301调查正按计划进行。
“这是他们首先应该采取的做法，”重新思考贸易总监洛里·瓦拉赫（Lori Wallach）表示，“针对特定国家的特定重商主义做法，这些做法导致长期的结构性产能过剩和极端的长期全球失衡。”瓦拉赫补充说，美国的贸易政策应该“如果各国停止抑制工资和消费、货币操纵和极端出口挂钩补贴等做法，则应提供更低的关税。”为了进一步搅浑水，特朗普政府还对欧盟征收15%的关税，声称其政策有些不合时宜。

【原文 English Original】
Read the top story of the day in your inbox. Sign up for the Daily Prospect newsletter here. While America was still reeling from the Nvidia scandal and Trump’s corrupt sellout of national security to China, in another part of the galaxy, Trump’s chief trade official, Jamieson Greer, announced a new round of tariffs on China as high as 45 percent, as retaliation against policies that create excess production capacity. In Trump World, one hand often doesn’t know what the other is doing. But this policy disconnect is extreme, even for Trump.  These tariffs, unlike the entirely illegal ones that Trump imposed based on whim, at least follow domestic law. They are the outgrowth of an investigation by USTR, under Sec. 301 of the Trade Act of the sources of global excess capacity. A normal administration would rely on the linkage of its diverse foreign policy levers and goals. If you don’t want us to raise tariffs, stop withholding exports of rare earth minerals; or stop menacing Taiwan; or stop cheating on export controls and devising subterfuges to import more advanced chips. A coherent administration might also link trade policy to domestic industrial policy. Increase tariffs against predatory trade policies so that the U.S. can rebuild technical and production capacity in, say, solar cells. But that’s not how Trump thinks. In one part of his addled brain, he knows that he loves tariffs. So let’s raise them again. In another part of his fragmented psyche, Trump sees Nvidia as a source of personal profit for himself and his cronies. So all is forgiven. For Trump, linkage means connecting his personal wealth to an abdication of export controls, not a strategic connection between tariffs and industrial policy. So Greer’s tariff program operates on autopilot and Trump notices only the headlines: Tariffs Good! One more detail. Greer, who is not part of Trump’s inner circle, reports to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. On the China/Nvidia front, Lutnick’s main contribution was to create new loopholes in export controls to facilitate the sale of high-end, ostensibly prohibited chips. Does Lutnick even pay attention to tariffs? You can imagine Greer presenting his findings and plan to Lutnick, and Lutnick responding, “Sure, whatever.” The irony is that Greer is one of the few competent people in the Trump administration. Trump undercut the mission of USTR by illegally raising tariffs on a whim until those illegal moves were blocked by the Supreme Court. Belatedly, the Sec. 301 investigation proceeded just as it was supposed to proceed. “This is the approach they should have taken in the first place,” says Lori Wallach, director of Rethink Trade, “targeting specific mercantilist practices in specific countries that lead to chronic, structural overcapacity and the extreme chronic global imbalances.” U.S. trade policy, Wallach added, should “offer lower tariffs if countries stop those practices like wage and consumption suppression, currency manipulation, and extreme export-tied subsidies.” Just to further muddy the waters, the Trump administration also imposed a 15 percent tariff on the EU, contending that its policies somehow added to global overcapacity. EU leaders indignantly rejected the finding. “We strongly reject the premise that Europe is a source of structural overcapacity. To the contrary, Europe is among those most exposed to overcapacity,” Olof Gill, the Commission’s deputy chief spokesperson, said in a statement. “The EU and the U.S. share a real concern about global overcapacity, much of it state-driven and concentrated in third countries. We regret the lack of joint action.” In a normal administration, Greer’s findings and announcement of higher tariffs would be prologue to the next round of trade talks with China, probably in January, where the threat of higher tariffs would be used as leverage for other U.S. goals, including changes in China’s predatory trade and industrial policies that have produced just the global excess capacity that Greer’s investigation documents. With Trump more concerned about photo ops with Xi Jinping and grifting opportunities with Nvidia, whether constructive trade negotiations will actually occur is anybody’s guess. The post Trump’s Incoherent Tariffs appeared first on The American Prospect .

title: Cyclic Materials picks Germany for first European plant
zh_title: 循环材料公司选择德国作为第一家欧洲工厂
summary: 稀土回收商 Cyclic Materials 在德国选择了一个地点作为其首个欧洲磁体回收设施，这标志着其国际扩张的一个里程碑。这家私营公司周四表示，在莱比锡附近施科保的陶氏价值园签署了一项设施土地预留协议。拟建工厂将为欧洲稀土回收网络奠定基础，有可能满足欧盟多达 15% 的稀土需求。 “欧洲知道可以通过国内循环稀土和关键矿产经济来实现经济弹性
content:
稀土回收商 Cyclic Materials 在德国选择了一个地点作为其首个欧洲磁体回收设施，这标志着其国际扩张的一个里程碑。这家私营公司周四表示，在莱比锡附近施科保的陶氏价值园签署了一项设施土地预留协议。拟建工厂将为欧洲稀土回收网络奠定基础，有可能满足欧盟多达 15% 的稀土需求。 Cyclic 首席执行官 Ahmad Ghahreman 在声明中表示：“欧洲知道通过国内循环稀土和关键矿产经济可以带来经济弹性。”这一扩张正值欧洲对稀土磁体的需求预计在未来十年内将增加一倍以上，而中国占全球加工稀土的 90%。回收可以帮助欧盟实现汽车、技术和国防工业必需材料的供应多元化，而无需开发新矿山。在微软（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）、亚马逊（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）和宝马（法国股票代码：BMW）等投资者的支持下，Cyclic 计划在德国工厂每年处理 25,000 吨磁力轴承废料。该工厂将为中央化学加工中心提供原料，回收的磁铁材料将在其中精炼并分离成稀土氧化物。 Ghahreman 告诉路透社，这家德国工厂是计划在欧洲建立的五个工厂中的第一个，预计于 2028 年开始运营。
该公司还在探索向中国以外的亚洲市场扩张。经过 17 个月的开发，Cyclic 于 9 月在亚利桑那州梅萨开设了第一家商业规模的磁体回收设施。该公司还在南卡罗来纳州建设一个综合回收园区。成本优势 Schkopau 工厂将使用 Cyclic 专有的 MagCycle 技术从废弃的电动机、硬盘、无人机和工业设备中提取永磁体。年产量可达 750 吨磁精矿、14,000 吨钢、4,600 吨铝和 3,000 吨铜。实地考察：Cyclic Materials 在亚利桑那州开设商业规模的稀土回收工厂 据路透社报道，额外金属的回收支撑了 Cyclic 的成本竞争力，非稀土材料占收入的 40% 至 50%。与 MP Materials（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MP）等已获得美国政府最低价格保证的生产商不同，Cyclic 表示，其生产成本使其无需类似支持即可运营。该公司还与电子产品回收商 ERI 合作，通过其美国收集网络确保原料安全，而其 REEPure 技术则在 10 月份登上《时代》杂志 2026 年最佳发明排行榜。当被问及潜在的首次公开募股时，Ghahreman 告诉路透社，Cyclic 此前已筹集 7500 万美元用于扩大其美国业务，并有多种筹集额外资金的选择。

【原文 English Original】
Rare earth recycler Cyclic Materials has selected a site in Germany for its first European magnet recovery facility, marking a milestone in its international expansion. The privately held company signed a land reservation agreement for a facility at the Dow ValuePark in Schkopau, near Leipzig, it said Thursday. The proposed plant would lay the groundwork for a European rare earth recovery network with the potential to meet as much as 15% of the EU’s rare earth needs. “Europe knows the economic resilience that can be delivered through a domestic, circular rare earth and critical mineral economy,” Cyclic CEO Ahmad Ghahreman said in the statement. The expansion comes as European demand for rare earth magnets is projected to more than double over the next decade, while China accounts for 90% of global processed rare earths. Recycling could help the European Union diversify its supplies of materials essential to the automotive, technology and defence industries without developing new mines. Backed by investors including Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) and BMW (FRA: BMW), Cyclic plans to process 25,000 tonnes of magnet-bearing scrap annually at the German facility. The plant would feed a central chemical processing hub, where recovered magnet material would be refined and separated into rare earth oxides. The German facility, the first of five planned for Europe, is slated to begin operations in 2028, Ghahreman told Reuters. The company is also exploring expansion into Asian markets outside China. Cyclic opened its first commercial-scale magnet recovery facility in Mesa, Arizona, in September following 17 months of development. It is also building an integrated recycling campus in South Carolina . Cost advantage The Schkopau plant would use Cyclic’s proprietary MagCycle technology to extract permanent magnets from discarded electric motors, hard drives, drones and industrial equipment. Annual output could reach 750 tonnes of magnet concentrate, alongside 14,000 tonnes of steel, 4,600 tonnes of aluminum and 3,000 tonnes of copper. Site visit: Cyclic Materials opens commercial-scale rare earth recycling plant in Arizona The recovery of additional metals underpins Cyclic’s cost competitiveness, with non-rare earth materials accounting for 40% to 50% of revenue, according to Reuters. Unlike producers such as MP Materials (NYSE: MP), which has secured minimum price guarantees from the US government, Cyclic says its production costs allow it to operate without similar support. The company has also partnered with electronics recycler ERI to secure feedstock through its US collection network, while its REEPure technology earned a spot on TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 list in October. Cyclic previously secured $75 million to expand its US operations and has several options for raising additional capital, Ghahreman told Reuters when asked about a potential initial public offering.

title: China’s Cargo Drones Keep Getting Bigger With New W8000
zh_title: 新型 W8000 助力中国货运无人机不断发展壮大
summary: 中国部署越来越大的无人货运飞机的野心正在不断增强，白鲸航空推出了 W8000 货运无人机，据报道，这款货运无人机设计可承载 8 吨（略低于 18,000 磅）。该飞机代表了该公司自主货运航空计划的重大扩展，恰逢其较小的 W5000 已开始飞行测试。参观者在珠海 W8000 前合影。来自中国互联网 W5000（左）停在珠海的 W8000 旁边。来自中国互联网 W8000先于中国国际航空展亮相珠海
content:
中国部署越来越大的无人货运飞机的野心正在不断增强，白鲸航空推出了 W8000 货运无人机，据报道，这款货运无人机设计可承载 8 吨（略低于 18,000 磅）。该飞机代表了该公司自主货运航空计划的重大扩展，恰逢其较小的 W5000 已开始飞行测试。参观者在珠海 W8000 前合影。来自中国互联网 W5000（左）停在珠海的 W8000 旁边。来自中国互联网 W8000 在中国国际航空航天博览会（俗称中国航展）之前亮相珠海。在 12 月 7 日该活动开幕之前，我们已经抢先了解了一个平台，该平台旨在将无人货运能力提升到目前仅限于传统载人运输机的水平。据报道，其有效载荷为 8 吨，大大高于 W5000，后者的设计载荷可达 5 吨（11,000 磅）。与 W5000 一样，W8000 可以通过后坡道装卸。 W8000 尾部的翻盖式门和后装载坡道。然而目前，双涡轮螺旋桨飞机 W8000 仍然是一个开发概念。其有效载荷只是设计目标，航程、最大起飞重量和操作要求等细节仍不清楚。
为了进行比较，八吨的有效载荷将使 W8000 与 DHC-5 Buffalo 双引擎涡轮螺旋桨短距起降运输机处于同一类别。无论如何，此次亮相凸显了白鲸航空开发一系列大型无人驾驶货运飞机的雄心，目标是区域货运、偏远地区物流和潜在的军事运输任务，在这些任务中，自主飞机可以比传统货运业务提供优势。珠海W8000的后视图。来自中国互联网 双涡轮螺旋桨飞机 W8000 动力装置所使用的发动机尚未确定。通过中国互联网 更大的无人运输 W8000 的有效负载能力将使其能够运输大型设备、托盘货物、工业用品和其他大件货物。在商业环境中，大型自主货运飞机在公路或铁路基础设施有限或传统航空运输过于昂贵而无法频繁运营的航线上特别有用。尽管消除了机上机组人员，但飞机仍然需要维护人员、地勤人员、货物装载基础设施和支持性运营网络。最终，该飞机也可能被批准在受控空域内运行，取代载人支线货运业务，但这种用例在未来仍有一段路要走。不可避免的是，该飞机的发展也表明了大型货运无人机的潜在军事意义。
珠海的 W5000 和 W8000。来自中国互联网 W8000 可以为中国人民解放军 (PLA) 提供大量额外的空运选择，以保障在偏远、孤立或基础设施匮乏的地点作战的部队。这在印度-太平洋地区尤其重要，中国不断扩大的军事设施和岛屿前哨网络已经对频繁的补给飞行产生了需求。例如，在南中国海，大型货运无人机可以将设备、医疗用品、备件和其他必需品运输到远程设施，而无需载人运输

【原文 English Original】
China’s ambitions to field increasingly large, uncrewed cargo aircraft are growing, with Air White Whale unveiling its W8000, a cargo UAV reportedly designed to carry up to eight metric tons — a little less than 18,000 pounds. The aircraft represents a significant expansion of the company’s plans for autonomous freight aviation, coming just as its smaller W5000 has begun flight testing. Visitors pose in front of the W8000 at Zhuhai. via Chinese internet The W5000 (left) parked next to the W8000 at Zhuhai. via Chinese internet The W8000 appeared in Zhuhai, ahead of the China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, commonly known as Airshow China . Before that event opens its doors on December 7, we have gotten an early look at a platform intended to push uncrewed cargo capacity into a class now limited to conventional, crewed transport aircraft. Its reported eight-ton payload would put it substantially above the W5000, which is designed to carry up to five metric tons (11,000 pounds). Like the W5000, the W8000 can be loaded and unloaded via a rear ramp. Clamshell doors and rear loading ramp in the tail of the W8000. via Chinese internet For now, however, the twin-turboprop W8000 remains a developmental concept. Its payload figure is a design target, and details about its range, maximum takeoff weight, and operational requirements are still unclear. For purposes of comparison, an eight-metric-ton payload would put the W8000 in much the same category as the DHC-5 Buffalo twin-engine turboprop STOL transport. Regardless, the unveiling highlights Air White Whale’s ambitions to develop a family of large uncrewed cargo aircraft, targeting regional freight, remote-area logistics, and potentially military transportation missions where autonomous aircraft could offer advantages over conventional cargo operations. Rear view of the W8000 at Zhuhai. via Chinese internet The engines used in the powerplant for the twin-turboprop W8000 are yet to be identified. via Chinese internet An Even Bigger Uncrewed Transport The W8000’s payload capacity would allow it to transport large equipment, palletized freight, industrial supplies, and other bulky cargo. In a commercial context, large autonomous cargo aircraft could be particularly useful on routes where road or rail infrastructure is limited, or where conventional air transport is too expensive to operate frequently. Although eliminating onboard flight crews, the aircraft would still require maintenance personnel, ground handling, cargo-loading infrastructure, and a supporting operational network. Ultimately, the aircraft could also be cleared to operate inside controlled airspace, displacing crewed feeder cargo operations, but that use case is still some way off in the future. Inevitably, the aircraft’s development also points toward the potential military relevance of large cargo UAVs. The W5000 and W8000 at Zhuhai. via Chinese internet The W8000 could offer the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) a substantial additional airlift option for sustaining forces operating from remote, isolated, or infrastructure-poor locations. This is particularly relevant in the Indo-Pacific, where China’s expanding network of military facilities and island outposts is already creating demand for frequent resupply flights. In the South China Sea, for example, large cargo UAVs could potentially transport equipment, medical supplies, spare parts, and other necessities to remote installations without requiring a crewed transport aircraft for every mission. They could also support operations in western China , including remote and high-altitude regions where road infrastructure is limited and conventional air transport can face additional challenges. There are also potential applications in a conflict, where conventional logistics infrastructure could be damaged or otherwise unavailable. Uncrewed transports would remove the risk to aircrews during routine resupply missions through contested airspace, although the aircraft themselves would remain vulnerable. They would also remove the need for combat search and rescue (CSAR) capabilities, which might be impossible to provide in at least some scenarios. Their usefulness would also depend, at least in some cases, on reliable communications, autonomous navigation, and the ability to operate without continuous access to satellite navigation. Profile view of the W8000 at Zhuhai. via Chinese internet W5000 Has Already Begun Flight Testing The W8000’s unveiling comes as Air White Whale’s smaller W5000 has reached a significant development milestone, completing its maiden flight on November 14. The five-ton cargo UAV reportedly conducted a roughly 30-minute test flight after taking off within approximately 600 meters (1,969 feet). During the flight, it reportedly conducted maneuvers and tested autonomous flight functions, datalink communications, propulsion, and flight-control systems before landing. China’s W5000 large cargo UAV has completed its maiden flight in the Ordos region of Inner Mongolia on 14 November. The aircraft reportedly took off after a 600 m (1,969 ft) ground run, climbed to 2,000 m (6,562 ft) and completed a 30-minute test flight. The trial included… pic.twitter.com/NNLqPKbLLZ — Drone Wars (@Drone_Wars_) November 14, 2026 The W5000 is designed to carry up to five metric tons of cargo, with a reported maximum range of 2,600 kilometers (1,616 miles), maximum takeoff weight of 10.8 tons (21,600 pounds), and cargo compartment volume exceeding 65 cubic meters (2,295 cubic feet). The aircraft is powered by twin turboprop engines. Chinese sources claim that Air White Whale has received 835 orders or prospective commitments from domestic logistics companies for the W5000, although the nature of those commitments and how many represent firm purchase contracts remain unclear. Commercial operations are currently planned to begin by the end of 2027, subject to further testing and certification. The W5000’s flight provides an indication of the company’s progress toward developing large uncrewed cargo aircraft, but the W8000 is a considerably more ambitious undertaking. Several other companies are also pursuing increasingly ambitious uncrewed transport aircraft. These include Tengden’s four-engine TB-001D Scorpion D , which first flew in October 2022 and is designed to carry up to 1.5 metric tons (3,307 pounds) of cargo, as well as the Star UAV System-developed AT200, another 1.5-ton-class cargo drone. The TB0D Scorpion D built by China’s Tengden Technology company completed its maiden flight in Sichuan on October 25, 2022. Twitter video screenshot Other designs include the state-owned Aviation Industry Corporation of China’s HH-100 , with a reported payload capacity of around 700 kilograms (1,543 pounds), and the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation’s CH-YH1000 , designed to carry approximately one metric ton (2,205 pounds). While these aircraft vary considerably in size, configuration, and intended missions, their development highlights China’s broader push to establish uncrewed cargo aviation as a viable logistics capability. A demonstrator of China’s HH-100 commercial cargo drone. Photo by Yue Shuhua/VCG via Getty Images VCG Outside of China, there is some other notable activity in this sector. The United States is also pursuing large uncrewed cargo aircraft for military logistics. As we reported , Textron Aviation and autonomy specialist Merlin recently unveiled the Cessna SkyCourier UX, a concept based on the twin-engine Cessna 408 SkyCourier. The proposed aircraft would use Merlin’s autonomous flight system and could carry approximately 6,000 pounds of cargo. Its designers are exploring a cockpit-less configuration with a hydraulically opening nose section for direct cargo loading, as well as kneeling landing gear and integrated loading systems to simplify operations at austere locations. With a reported range of around 900 nautical miles, the SkyCourier UX is intended to support distributed military forces, including across the Pacific, where it could move supplies between larger logistics hubs and smaller, remote operating locations. The U.S. Air Force has also experimented with autonomous Cessna Caravan aircraft through Joby Aviation and its former Xwing autonomy team, including logistics demonstrations across the Pacific. Better known for land vehicles, Oshkosh Defense also recently announced a partnership with Silicon Valley startup Grid Aero, with the aim of building large military cargo drones. These would draw upon Grid Aero’s experience developing the Lifter family, an autonomous aircraft series with modular payload capacity that the company describes as a “pickup truck of the skies.” The Lifter is planned to carry somewhere between 1,000 and 8,000 pounds over a distance of approximately 1,500 miles.  The Grid Aero Lifter. Oshkosh/Grid Aero While the United States is moving slower than China in this space, there is arguably an even stronger operational case for such capabilities in the U.S. military, given the expeditionary nature of a potential conflict across the vast distances of the Indo-Pacific . Sustaining forces spread across widely separated islands, remote airfields, and austere forward operating locations would place enormous demands on conventional airlift and sealift networks. China Targets A New Class Of Cargo Aviation Overall, the development of the W5000 and W8000 highlights China’s growing interest in cargo UAVs capable of moving freight measured in metric tons rather than kilograms. While smaller delivery drones are increasingly being explored for last-mile transportation, aircraft such as the W8000 are aimed at moving substantial loads between logistics hubs without requiring an onboard crew. If the W8000 progresses, it could eventually offer a heavier transport option alongside the W5000, allowing Air White Whale to target different cargo requirements and routes. The W5000 and W8000 at Zhuhai ahead of Airshow China. via Chinese internet For now, the W8000 points to where Air White Whale wants to take its cargo UAV program. The W5000’s flight-test program will be an important step in establishing whether the company can turn its designs into operational aircraft and start to offer a new class of uncrewed airlift. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China’s Cargo Drones Keep Getting Bigger With New W8000 appeared first on TWZ .

title: 港府為外賣平台工作者提工傷保障立法 勞權監察批淪「次等勞工」變相被剝削
summary: 文章来源：追光者 作者：梁銘康 在香港從事外賣平台速遞等配送服務的「平台工作者」過去幾年多次發起罷工，爭取改善待遇及報酬。港府今年7月就加強平台工作者權益提出立法框架，但被指漏洞百出，包括未有設立工傷病假期間「每月最低收入」等。香港勞權監察發表報告，批評港府提出的框架將平台工作者界定為「次等勞工」，部分人所獲保障不進反退，警告若港府不正視問題，平台行業的勞資矛盾勢必越演越烈。 勞權監察周一（23日）發表題為《聊勝於無？香港政府建議為平台工作者設立的工傷補償機制》的報告，批評港
content: 文章来源：追光者 作者：梁銘康 在香港從事外賣平台速遞等配送服務的「平台工作者」過去幾年多次發起罷工，爭取改善待遇及報酬。港府今年7月就加強平台工作者權益提出立法框架，但被指漏洞百出，包括未有設立工傷病假期間「每月最低收入」等。香港勞權監察發表報告，批評港府提出的框架將平台工作者界定為「次等勞工」，部分人所獲保障不進反退，警告若港府不正視問題，平台行業的勞資矛盾勢必越演越烈。 勞權監察周一（23日）發表題為《聊勝於無？香港政府建議為平台工作者設立的工傷補償機制》的報告，批評港府的立法建議迴避平台工作者最核心的勞工權益問題，拒絕確立他們的僱員身份，更透過界定工作者資格、限制受保障的工作時段及壓低補償計算基礎等安排，層層收窄工傷保障範圍，令平台工作者最終只獲遠遜於一般僱員的次等保障。 報告批立法框架存在多個漏洞 報告指港府的立法框架存在若干明顯缺陷，包括等單、搶單期間受傷不受保障；兼職平台工作者若不幸因工受傷，其他非平台工作收入不計算在工傷補償以內；計算平台工作者在工傷病假期間的按期付款時，不設類似現行《僱員補償條例》下的「每月最低收入」規定 ；替工及經中介聘用的平台工作者更可能完全被拒諸門外。 有別於新加坡《2024年平台工作者法》（Platform Workers Act 2024） ，港府提出的立法框架完全無條文規定營運者，要採取措施保障平台工作者的安全及健康。勞權監察批評「只賠不防」在政策上說不通，強調工傷的補償與預防兩者密不可分。 質疑無異於變相剝削 勞權監察形容港府的立法框架，由界定工作者身份、工傷發生時間，到計算補償金額皆「處處設限」，不斷收窄營運者的責任，把平台工作者的保障壓低至遠遜於一般僱員的水平，變相剝削，令人質疑立法是為保障平台工作者，抑或為平台營運者卸責打開方便之門 。報告又指最低工資及監管平台演算法等其他勞工權益，完全無納入框架。一旦落實，平台工作者除了將被長期排除於基本勞工權益之外，遇上工傷時能否維持生活也成疑問。 報告提出多項補救建議，包括將工傷保障範圍，擴展至平台工作者登入其帳戶期間發生的意外；訂明「每月最低收入」適用於暫時喪失工作能力的按期付款等；提出將勞資審裁處的司法管轄權擴展至平台工作者等長期政策倡議。勞權監察總幹事蒙兆達指，縱然近年香港政治氣氛高壓下，仍爆發多宗 「 外賣車手」工潮，反映平台工作者的怨氣正日益加深，警告若港府不正視問題，平台行業的勞資矛盾只會越演越烈。

title: Amphibs USS Makin Island, USS John P. Murtha Depart Singapore

summary: 黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日抵达日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 和两栖运输船坞号 USS 约翰·P·默斯 a (LPD-26) 于周二从新加坡三巴旺出发，前往印度洋。根据当地船舶观察员和 AIS 数据，马金岛号和约翰·P·默塔号随第 13 海军陆战队远征部队的部队出发，正在通过马六甲海峡向北航行。 AIS数据显示两艘船当时位于马六甲以南的马六甲海峡
content:
黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日抵达日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 和两栖运输船坞号 USS 约翰·P·默斯 a (LPD-26) 于周二从新加坡三巴旺出发，前往印度洋。根据当地船舶观察员和 AIS 数据，马金岛号和约翰·P·默塔号随第 13 海军陆战队远征部队的部队出发，正在通过马六甲海峡向北航行。 AIS数据显示，两艘船于晚上10点位于马来西亚首都吉隆坡以南的马六甲海峡。当地时间，美国海军拉帕汉诺克号舰队加油船 (T-AO-204)。马金岛、约翰·P·穆萨、两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和已登船的第 13 远征远征队组成了马金岛两栖准备大队。安克雷奇及其第 13 海军陆战队远征部队分队目前驻扎在日本横须贺司令舰队活动司令部 (CFAY)。据 USNI News 此前报道，ARG 于 9 月 28 日从圣地亚哥出发。第13远征部队的海军陆战队空地特遣部队包括第13远征部队指挥分队、作为地面作战分队的第2/4营登陆队和作为其后勤分队的第13战斗后勤营。航空中队包括海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（增援）和海军陆战队战斗机攻击中队 (VMFA) 211，其中包括 MV-22B 鱼鹰、CH-53、AH-1Z 毒蛇和 F-35B 闪电 II。
ARG 于 10 月初驶入夏威夷进行港口访问，然后穿越太平洋。安克雷奇于 10 月 21 日至 22 日对关岛进行了短暂访问，然后重新加入 ARG，并于 10 月 26 日驶入 CFAY 进行港口访问。所有三艘 ARG 舰艇均于 11 月 7 日从 CFAY 出发，与约翰·P·穆萨号和安克雷奇号一起参加“马拉巴尔 2026”演习的海上阶段，这是澳大利亚、日本、印度和美国“四方”伙伴关系下的年度海军演习。演习于 11 月 5 日至 12 日在横须贺及其周边地区举行。印度海军什瓦里克级隐形多用途护卫舰INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰HMAS Stuart (FFH 153)和美国海军圣安东尼奥级两栖运输舰2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间，美国海军安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·P·穆萨 (LPD-26) 号船坞编队在西太平洋航行，2026 年 11 月 7 日。美国海军照片 与约翰·P·穆萨和安克雷奇一起参加演习的有日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS 伊势 (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS 最上(FFM-1)、一艘日本海上自卫队潜艇、印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F49)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH153)、一架美国海军 P-8A 海神海上巡逻机和一架日本海上自卫队 P-1 MPA。演习活动包括海军炮火、反水面战演习和反潜战演习。伊势和约翰·P.
穆萨号进行了互访、登船、搜查和扣押（VBSS）演习。“马拉巴尔2026”号完成后，约翰·P·穆萨号前往菲律宾海与马金岛会合。据当地船舶观察员称，“安克雷奇”号于 11 月 13 日在横须贺近海抛锚，并于 11 月 16 日停靠在 CFAY，占据了离开的潜艇母舰弗兰克·电缆号 (AS-40) 所腾出的空间。马金岛号和约翰·P·默撒号于周五穿越南中国海，驶入新加坡三巴旺进行港口访问。海军和五角大楼都没有表示安克雷奇是否会加入马

【原文 English Original】
Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) pulls in to Commander, Fleet Activities, Yokosuka, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026. US Navy photo Amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) and amphibious transport dock USS John P. Murth a (LPD-26) departed Tuesday from Sembawang, Singapore, and are heading toward the Indian Ocean. Makin Island and John P. Murtha , embarked with elements of the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit, are transiting north through the Malacca Strait, according to local ship spotters and AIS data. AIS data shows the two ships were in the Malacca Strait south of Malaysia’s capital of Kuala Lumpur at 10 p.m. local time with fleet oiler USNS Rappahannock (T-AO-204). Makin Island , John P. Murtha , amphibious transport dock USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and the embarked 13th MEU form the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group. Anchorage and its embarked 13th MEU elements are currently at Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY), Japan. The ARG departed from San Diego on Sept. 28, USNI News previously reported . The 13th MEU’s Marine Air-Ground Task Force includes the 13th MEU command element, Battalion Landing Team 2/4 as the Ground Combat Element and Combat Logistics Battalion 13 as its logistic element. The aviation squadrons are Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364 (Reinforced) and Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 211, which includes MV-22B Ospreys, CH-53s, AH-1Z Vipers and F-35B Lightning IIs. The ARG pulled into Hawaii for a port visit in early October before transiting the Pacific. Anchorage made a short visit to Guam from Oct. 21-22 before rejoining the ARG, which pulled into CFAY on Oct. 26 for a port visit. All three ARG ships departed Nov. 7 from CFAY with John P. Murtha and Anchorage participating in the sea phase of Exercise Malabar 2026, an annual naval exercise under the “Quad” partnership of Australia, Japan, India and the U.S. The exercise ran from Nov. 5-12 in and around Yokosuka. Indian Navy Shivalik-class stealth multi-role frigate INS Sahyadri (F 49), Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hyuga-class helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH 182), Mogami-class frigate JS Mogami (FFM 1), Royal Australian Navy Anzac-class frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) and U.S. Navy San Antonio-class amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) sail in formation in the Western Pacific Ocean during Exercise Malabar 2026, Nov. 7, 2026. US Navy photo Participating in the drills alongside John P. Murtha and Anchorage were Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182), frigate JS Mogami (FFM-1), a JMSDF submarine, Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49), Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153), a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon Maritime Patrol Aircraft and a JMSDF P-1 MPA. Exercise activities included naval gunfire, anti-surface warfare drills and anti-submarine warfare drills. Ise and John P. Murtha carried out reciprocal visit, board, search, and seizure (VBSS) drills . Following completion of Malabar 2026, John P. Murtha headed out to the Philippine Sea to join Makin Island . Anchorage anchored offshore at Yokosuka on Nov. 13 and docked into CFAY on Nov. 16, taking the space vacated by departing submarine tender USS Frank Cable (AS-40), according to local ship spotters . Makin Island and John P. Murtha transited the South China Sea and pulled into Sembawang, Singapore on Friday for a port visit. The Navy nor the Pentagon has said whether Anchorage will join Makin Island and John P. Murtha . Makin Island and John P. Murtha are heading towards the Indian Ocean. Makin Island and John P. Murtha are expected to relieve the Boxer ARG in the Middle East. The Boxer ARG, which includes amphibious assault ship USS Boxer (LHD-4), amphibious dock landing ship USS Comstock (LSD-45) and amphibious transport dock USS Portland (LPD-27) and the embarked 11th MEU, deployed out from the West Coast in March, USNI News reported , putting it at eight months deployed. Boxer and Comstock were operating in U.S. Central Command as of Monday while Portland was operating in U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations, according to the USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker .
